topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I open the door, breath catching as I see the package. It's heavy, too, this unexpected weight. I knew we should’ve changed the address weeks ago. My fingers fumble with the tracking slip, hoping against hope for some mistake. But no, it’s clear as day: this was sent to the old tenant. I can’t just leave it; what if it’s something important? Yet, the thought of dealing with the mess, finding the right person... It feels like an insurmountable task. I need to sit down, think. This can’t be happening.
